title: I made a game about flipping pogs(taso)
author: ismaildev
selftext:
Hey everyone, I’ve been working on **Taso Idle**, an idle game inspired by the tasos/pogs we used to play with as kids. You flip them, sell your stack, buy upgrades, and get little brothers to help you out.

There’s a **free web demo on** [**itch.io**](https://allotropygames.itch.io/taso-idle), so you can try it right in your browser. Would love to hear what you think, especially if something feels confusing or gets boring.

If you like it, a [**wishlist on Steam**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5511380/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=aigamedev) would really help me out. Thanks for taking a look!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/ismaildev please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.
